target.title: feat(ios): implement branded typography design system
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The iOS app had inconsistent typography coverage: many screens and controls still rendered with default system fonts, which made the branded iOS experience uneven and easy to regress as new SwiftUI surfaces were added.

## Why This Change Was Made

This PR adds and applies the iOS branded typography system across app, shared chat, watch, and Live Activity surfaces using Red Hat Display, Inter, and JetBrains Mono. It also aligns bundled third-party license acknowledgements, adds scoped iOS agent guidance for typography work, and expands typography tests so bare text/control regressions are caught before review.

## User Impact

Users should see branded typography consistently across Settings, Gateway, Chat, Onboarding, Agent, Talk, alerts, menus, toolbar actions, picker rows, secure-field placeholders, and supporting controls. Dynamic Type remains supported, and custom secure-field placeholder styling preserves accessibility labels.

## Evidence

- Rebased on latest `origin/main` at `5361e5a0b45`.
- Focused typography tests passed:
  `xcodebuild -quiet -project apps/ios/OpenClaw.xcodeproj -scheme OpenClaw -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro Max' -only-testing:OpenClawTests/OpenClawTypographyTests test`
- Formatting/whitespace checks passed:
  `swiftformat --lint --config config/swiftformat apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Sources/OpenClawChatUI/ChatView.swift`
  `git diff --check`
- Fresh autoreview after the rebase follow-up reported no accepted/actionable findings:
  `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local`

Known limits: this evidence is simulator/build/test based; it is not a full physical-device or VoiceOver pass.
